content.text:
Here's my thinking as I scrolled, then what I'd tell a friend.

- Big heading "מדריך". Under it: "כל סוג של חיסכון והשקעה שהאתר מכסה". Good, that's literally what I came for.
- "שני חלקים בכל חיסכון": "איפה הכסף מוחזק" and "במה הכסף מושקע". OK, that clicks: the box, and what's inside the box.
- "מאיפה להתחיל" has three short lines. "שכירים שהמעסיק מפקיד להם: קרן השתלמות". That's me, I already have one. "כסף שצריך להישאר זמין: קרן כספית". Hm, maybe that's for some of the 30k.
- Then loads of cards. "כסף שוטף וקצר": עו"ש, פיקדון, תכנית חיסכון, קרן כספית, קרן כספית מתחדשת, מק"מ. Skipped מק"מ, no idea what it is.
- "חיסכון עם הטבת מס": קרן השתלמות, and "קופת גמל להשקעה". That sounds like a pension thing for old people. The first line says "שמפקידים אליה בעצמכם... אפשר למשוך בכל עת". Huh, so it isn't locked? Not sure.
- "פרישה" is pension stuff. Scrolled past. "לילדים", scrolled past.
- "לבחירה עצמית": "חשבון ניירות ערך". "בבנק, בבית השקעות... קונים, מוכרים ומחזיקים מניות, קרנות". That's the "invest in the S&P" thing, I think.
- "במה הכסף מושקע", and here's "מדד S&P 500"! "הכסף מושקע בדולרים דרך קרן שעוקבת אחריו." Fine.
- Lots of index cards (MSCI, נאסד"ק, ת"א-35, ת"א-125, ת"א-90). They all end the same way: "הכסף מושקע בשקלים דרך קרן שעוקבת אחריו, עם חשיפה לדולר או מנוטרלת ממנו". I had to read it again on every card just to find what was different. Annoying.
- אג"ח cards with "צמודה" / "לא צמודה". Skipped them.
- Footer. Done.

**What I'd tell a friend:**
I didn't decide anything, but I came away with a short list. It's a list of names. Nothing in it tells you what to pick. There's no number anywhere: no returns, no fees in shekels, nothing. Fairly sure of the list itself.

What I took from it: it's two separate questions. Where the money sits (bank account, savings fund, investment account) and what it's invested in (S&P, the Tel Aviv 35, bonds). For me, worth looking into:
- my קרן השתלמות, since I already have it
- "חשבון ניירות ערך" for the S&P 500
- "קרן כספית" for money I might need soon
- maybe "קופת גמל להשקעה", if it really says you can take the money out whenever. I'm not sure I read that right.

Where I looked: the heading, the "מאיפה להתחיל" bit, the card titles, and the first line of a few cards. I skipped the pension, kids, bonds and מק"מ cards. I didn't tap into anything; I didn't open any card.

Words I didn't get: מק"מ, אג"ח צמודה / לא צמודה, "מנוטרלת ממנו", "חשיפה לדולר", MSCI AC World, קרן כספית מתחדשת, "ניהול אישי".

What bugged me:
- There's no "first thing to do". "מאיפה להתחיל" mostly points at pension stuff.
- About 30 cards that all look the same.
- The index cards repeat the same sentence over and over.
- The S&P card says "בדולרים" but the others say "בשקלים". I didn't get why that matters.

I'd probably have closed it after the index cards and just asked someone at work.

input.answer: I didn't decide anything. I came away with a short list to look into: my קרן השתלמות, a חשבון ניירות ערך for the S&P 500, and a קרן כספית for money I might need soon, plus maybe קופת גמל להשקעה. The page names the types but gives no numbers, no fees and no clear first step.

stuck.why: I thought it was a pension thing for older people, but the card says you can withdraw at any time. I wasn't sure I read it right.
I expected a first step for my 30k. It points to קרן השתלמות and קרן חדשה מקיפה, which are things I already have through work.
They all look alike. I couldn't tell which one matters for me, so I would rather do nothing.
